profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full Stack Engineer eager to solve problems with technology. Originally trained in Microsoft stack (AngularJS/.NET/SQL), with considerable experience in MERN, currently working in React/.NET/SQL. Thrilled by opportunities to teach/share concepts to those who want to learn.

positions.title: Engineering Lead
positions.description:
Develop credit modeling and credit decision services (SaaS) for external banks and other lending institutions (i.e. Siemens, SNB Bank).

Single-handedly design and implement unit testing pattern for use across entire Node code base (over a dozen microservices) utilizing mocha, chai, and sinon.

Work closely with Technical Project Manager/Scrum Master and Product team to determine level of effort for incoming feature requests, identify areas of risk, and provide suggestions for implementation.

Participate in team-wide effort to rewrite the company's internally-used application, migrating from AngularJS (1.6) to React.

Establish and host/present at monthly "Brown Bag" event to promote continuing education across a wide range of topics including: Salesforce, features/microservices, Docker, Ticketmaster Tech Maturity Model, etc.

Suggest/host "Think Tank" meeting to elicit ideas/strategies for improving the platform; work with the team to prioritize tasks and create JIRA tickets; negotiate with Technical Project Manager/Scrum Master to allow room in sprints for completion of platform improvements.

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Designed event-based solution, utilizing Azure Event Grid, to allow for automatic generation of stipulations by internal credit decision engine, external file upload functionality by users, and bi-directional communication of stipulation status to/from client-facing UI and internally-used Salesforce.

Provided guidance on feature design and implementation to fellow developers; collaborate with Salesforce administrators to address integrations between the CRM and other internal systems.

Led on-boarding sessions for new hires in order to provide an overview of system architecture and flow of data through our systems.

Researched, planned, prototyped and implemented a variety of third party integrations, including Google Distance Matrix, LaunchDarkly feature flags, Docusign, Plaid, and others.

Reviewed coding assessments and conduct phone screens/panel interviews for prospective candidates.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Improved and extended functionality of .NET internal credit decision engine: completed underwriting report generation from customer's credit reports, coded new rules specified by the business, fixed bugs and resolved issues to ensure more accurate credit decisioning.

Built API for external vendors to submit requests for vendor/website set-up, automated processes in Mongo-backed microservices, Marketo and Salesforce.

Built front-end application in AngularJS for BigTex/ATW to capture user submissions for equipment financing, provided pricing options to the user, and emailed contracts for signature via Docusign.

Built and deployed Express/Node email microservice for internal use; configured emails to send via AWS SES; developed Mongo-backed solution to process bounces/complaints, and generated email blacklist in order to protect dedicated IP reputation.

Maintained and developed across .NET 4.7, .NET Core 2, Express/Node microservices, and AngularJS applications; produced reports and performed data pulls in SQL, MongoDB, and Salesforce; completed assigned JIRA tickets across over a dozen microservices; configured and deployed assets in Azure.

positions.title: Freelance Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Architected full-stack multi-screen trivia game solution in jQuery/.NET/SQL for one-time use at company event (AT&T/DIRECTV), backed by AWS RDS in the cloud.

Captured users' pictures for hosting in AWS S3 buckets, utilized 3rd party slot machine plugin to randomize users' trivia questions, integrated video playback to enhance UX, and implemented auto-scrolling and auto-refreshing leaderboard to display user images aside their scores.

Remoted into client's computer on location in Toronto for final style modifications and to ensure smooth rollout.

positions.title: Lab Instructor
positions.description:
Taught labs of up to 12 students, covering full-stack software development concepts: HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, Javascript, jQuery, AJAX, REST Client, APIs, .NET, MVC, relational database design, stored procedures, ADO.NET, request-response life-cycle, and building a basic CRUD app.

Developed lessons and assignments based off videos provided to students by the program.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Optio (http://optiola.azurewebsites.net) is a startup company implementing job placement and training for executive protection and other security professionals

Contribution Highlights:
•	Adapted ASP.NET Identity to be accessible via WebAPIs; constructed security token system for use with several features (including email confirmation and password reset which leverage SendGrid API for distribution)
•	Created User Admin Dashboard to search and filter users with a user-friendly UI that includes pagination and “jump to page” functionality
•	Implemented jQuery UI drag and drop widget into the course creation workflow allowing for personalization of courses
•	Refactored and optimized our Quiz data schema and stored procedures as well as the service layer and API endpoints
•	Constructed services that facilitate the evaluation of machine gradable quizzes, score and flag when appropriate for persistence and review, and allow for deep cloning of any given quiz
•	Consumed Quiz API into a set of Angular-based views allowing users to take and review quizzes and giving administrators the ability to evaluate any quiz that contained non-objective answers
•	Enhanced the Quiz administrative features by overlaying quiz data/statistics over C3.js charts and graphs
•	Integrated Google Maps API into our Angular-based job listings search results page utilizing custom directives to manipulate and interact with the map including marker and info window events
•	Abstracted Quiz-based components into separate libraries to ensure plug and play reusability via dependency injection

Technologies include: AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery, AngularJS, Bootstrap 3.0, CSS3, Google Maps API, Twilio API, SendGrid API, Visual Studio 2015, Team Foundation Server (TFS), C#, ASP.NET Identity, MVC 5, Web Api 2.0, MVC Attribute Routing, ADO.NET, SQL Server Management Studio, Transact-SQL

positions.title: Hackathon Participant - 2nd place finish
positions.description: •	Deployed responsive web application on Azure (http://youngfullstacks.azurewebsites.net/main/main) that leverages Google Maps API geocoding and Google Places API to meet friends at locations central to all given addresses, and sends a hyperlink to search results to all given phone numbers via Twilio API

positions.title: Head Instructor
positions.description:
•	Interviewed, hired, trained, and managed a staff of 7 ESL instructors; improved teaching efficacy and student management techniques through biweekly professional development workshops
•	Taught three-hour English lessons to students with class sizes up to 24 students delivering curriculum through a variety of LMS systems via tablet learning platforms
•	Authored original debate class curriculum;  led bi-weekly essay writing workshops
